Mahjong Card Cover Maker

Put a name and your club on Christmas card covers and sleeves. One cover per name, so the whole club's covers print in one go.

Make your covers in 3 steps

1 Type the names, your club, a greeting, and pick designs and your card size.
2 Click Make my covers and check the preview at the bottom.
3 Click Print / Save as PDF. Choose Actual size / 100%, then cut and fold.
🔒 Nothing you type leaves this device: no account, no upload. Your form is kept only in this browser, so it is still here next time. Clear everything removes it.
